body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Cresyn presented ''CS-BH200'' a 10g portable Bluetooth headset with a built-in battery. It runs for 10 hours for talk time or 170 hours of standby time per 2 hours charge.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
